description: Self-propelled deforming 6DOF body (X 195): 2D anguilliform swimmer of Kern & Koumoutsakos (2006) (STL, L = 1, linear envelope 0.125 L, wave length L, 1 Hz, ramp 0.1 s, recoil on), neutrally buoyant, free surge, heave and pitch (X 11 1 0 1 0 1 0), single phase (F 30 0), stabilised coupling X 197 8 (added mass of the equivalent elliptic cylinder).
covers: sixdof_deform: mass distribution of the hull, recoil, ramp
update_forcing: deformation velocity in the direct forcing (X 14 1)
deform_stage: stage times of TVD RK3
